name: Drake Industrial Falling-Object Protection Vest
description:
A heavy vest with rigid plates on the shoulders and upper back, designed to protect against falling debris in construction and demolition environments. The vest distributes impact force across a wide area and includes a high-visibility reflective panel on the back. A built-in collar extension protects the neck from vertical impacts.

Mandatory in every construction zone in GLMZ — not because regulations require it, but because insurance policies do. The vest is uncomfortable, heavy, and saves about forty lives per year in the city's construction sector.
functionality: Overhead impact protection, debris deflection, high-visibility marking
what_it_says: Things fall where you work and your back is designed to handle it.
story_hooks: A Falling-Object Vest's impact plates show damage from a single, precisely centered strike — not random debris, but something dropped deliberately from above.
